ideaContract.purpose: Prove that one logical operation can traverse the canonical NEO REZONANS system without losing identity, causal lineage, evidence lineage, or leaking execution authority.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: A deterministic synthetic receipt binds all eight stages and all eight transfers to one logical_operation_id and the canonical system snapshot while preserving the single explicit authority boundary.
invariants: one logical_operation_id survives every stage and transfer
each stage names the immediately preceding stage as causal parent
each stage after the first inherits the previous stage evidence reference
only the LiminalOSAI to ContractGraph-QA edge may transfer explicit authorization
no stage performs an external effect or mutates source history
RINSE feedback returns an evidence-bound reflection rather than executable authority
forbiddenOutcomes: authority transfer on a non-authority edge
external side effect during the synthetic proof

evidence.claim: The canonical system snapshot defines the exact layer order, transfer facts, authority mode, and feedback boundary consumed by the receipt validator.
The synthetic trace carries one logical operation through every canonical layer and transfer without external effects.
The validator recomputes identity, causal/evidence lineage, edge semantics, authority transfer count, feedback count, and deterministic receipt digests.

past.summary: FCRP-SYSTEM-001 proved the canonical cross-repository topology and transfer boundaries, but it did not prove that one concrete logical operation could traverse the complete loop.

present.summary: NEO-REZONANS-E2E-001 exercises all eight stages and transfers under one synthetic logical operation and produces a deterministic system receipt.

future.summary: A later runtime integration may replace synthetic stage producers, but it must preserve the same identity, lineage, authority, and non-mutation invariants or version the contract explicitly.

causalPath.statement: The system had a machine-readable canonical topology and transfer contract but no dynamic proof that one operation could traverse it end to end.
A synthetic trace introduces one logical_operation_id across all eight canonical layers and the closing feedback transfer.
The receipt requires contiguous parent-stage lineage and inherited evidence lineage while rejecting logical-operation identity drift.
Exactly one explicit authority transfer is permitted at LiminalOSAI to ContractGraph-QA and every non-authority edge fails closed on leaked authority.
Proof, durable state, and reinterpretation preserve evidence lineage while external effects and source mutation remain forbidden in the synthetic traversal.
The deterministic receipt closes the loop with REFLECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE, zero authority leaks, zero external effects, and zero source mutation.

navigation.reason: The missing guarantee existed above individual repositories: topology was proven, but whole-operation continuity across the composed system was not.

refactor.change: Introduce a canonical synthetic end-to-end trace plus deterministic system receipt validator bound to the canonical system snapshot.
refactor.expectedEffect: A single logical operation becomes machine-verifiable across identity, causal/evidence lineage, authority transfer, proof, persistence, reflection, and feedback boundaries.

authorization.authorityBoundary: FCRP-SYSTEM-002 validates a synthetic composition proof only; PASS does not authorize repository mutation, provider calls, deployment, financial action, or any external effect.
